lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
groupfolders-initFiles: 674 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 674 B.
All 3 pages load the same 1 file: 142,794 B raw, 53,891 B gzip, 30.2 % of the smallest page (groupfolders-initFiles, 472,915 B).
Inside: @vue/runtime-core 48,698 B, dompurify 30,405 B, @vue/runtime-dom 18,242 B, @vue/reactivity 17,951 B, semver 9,041 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 57,704 B on the groupfolders-initFiles page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
@babel/runtime, 5,025 B on the groupfolders-settings page: transpiler helpers, one copy per build target.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (174 packages, 1,240 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
